note: Build the index without blocking writes. CONCURRENTLY takes only a SHARE UPDATE EXCLUSIVE lock, so inserts and reads keep running (a plain CREATE INDEX would block inserts for the whole build and they would hit the app's 2 s timeout). It must be the only statement here: CONCURRENTLY cannot run inside a transaction block.

Check that the build finished and the index is valid and usable. If not, stop the plan here (a failed concurrent build leaves an INVALID index that has to be dropped with DROP INDEX CONCURRENTLY before trying again).
